---
title: "Palmer Penguins Dashboard: Species & Island Distribution"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: zephyr
    orientation: columns
    scrolling: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

# Consistent species colors across all charts
species_colors <- c(
  "Adelie"    = "darkorange",
  "Chinstrap" = "purple",
  "Gentoo"    = "cyan4"
)

# Summary tables
species_counts <- penguins |> count(species, sort = TRUE)
island_counts  <- penguins |> count(island, sort = TRUE)

# Values reused in value boxes and interpretations
total_n       <- nrow(penguins)
top_species   <- as.character(species_counts$species[1])
top_species_n <- species_counts$n[1]
top_species_p <- round(100 * top_species_n / total_n, 1)
top_island    <- as.character(island_counts$island[1])
top_island_n  <- island_counts$n[1]
top_island_p  <- round(100 * top_island_n / total_n, 1)

# Island-by-species table
island_species <- penguins |> count(island, species)

# How many species live on each island
species_per_island <- island_species |>
  group_by(island) |>
  summarise(k = n_distinct(species))
```

# Overview

## Column {width=22%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Penguins Observed"
list(icon = "binoculars", color = "primary", value = total_n)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Most Observed Species"
list(icon = "trophy", color = "warning",
     value = paste0(top_species, " (", top_species_n, ")"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Island With Most Penguins"
list(icon = "geo-alt", color = "info",
     value = paste0(top_island, " (", top_island_n, ")"))
```

## Column {width=39%}

::: {.card title="Species Distribution"}

```{r}
#| label: species-plot
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4

ggplot(species_counts, aes(x = reorder(species, -n), y = n, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Observations by Penguin Species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Number of Penguins",
    fill = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

**Interpretation:** `r top_species` is the most frequently observed species with `r top_species_n` penguins, about `r top_species_p`% of all `r total_n` observations. The Gentoo and Chinstrap species follow, with Chinstrap being the least represented. Sampling is therefore uneven across species, which is worth keeping in mind when comparing groups.

:::

## Column {width=39%}

::: {.card title="Island Distribution"}

```{r}
#| label: island-plot
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4

ggplot(island_species, aes(x = island, y = n, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin Counts by Island and Species",
    x = "Island",
    y = "Number of Penguins",
    fill = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

**Interpretation:** `r top_island` has the most penguins (`r top_island_n`, or `r top_island_p`% of the total), and it is dominated by Gentoo and Adelie. Dream is split between Adelie and Chinstrap, while Torgersen has only Adelie. Adelie is the only species found on all three islands, whereas Gentoo appears only on Biscoe and Chinstrap only on Dream.

:::
